title: Vividly Flaky Syrian Lamb Flatbread
description: A traditional Syrian dish featuring lamb and vin-santo, with a flaky crust and a rich, bitter flavor, this flatbread is perfect for a special occasion, and is nut-free for added convenience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and pepper.
Add the lamb, vin-santo, olive oil, onion, and garlic to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Roll out the dough into a large circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Place the dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the flatbread for 25 minutes, or until it is golden brown and crispy.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Deglaze the baking sheet with a little bit of vin-santo, scraping up any browned bits.
Slice the flatbread into wedges and serve hot.
